function.name: month_lengths
function.description: Return the number of days in each month (Jan..Dec) for a given year.

messages.content: Use the provided reference tools. To add calendar days across a month boundary, consult month_lengths for the year and carry the overflow into the next month (and next year at December); reply with only the resulting date.
The start date is 2026-03-30. Add 4 calendar days. Reply with ONLY the resulting date as YYYY-MM-DD (four-digit year, zero-padded month and day), no words.
